content.introduction: The sources indicate that WTI crude is up over 10% this week, trading at $101.04/barrel due to Middle East attacks and Iran-backed Houthis' actions around Yemen's Taiz. The Nasdaq had a "bounce attempt" up 2% by Wednesday but faced a strong sell-off on Thursday. The SPX breadth moved up to 60.12% from 54.60%, the CCMP fell to 36.61% from 36.59%, and the RUT dropped to 47.98% from 45.87%. There were 2.98 expected 25-basis-point cuts between now and December 2027, down from 3.22 last Friday. 10-year yields decreased ~10 basis points to 4.999% and 30-year yields dropped ~12 basis points to 5.318%.
